items.q: and me and Urbie Green , you know, we played along with the big band

ctx.x: there. So that wasn't nothing. You do that one week, then you had to wait another month or two before you'd go again.

So I run into Sammy on Broadway, Sammy Burke. And Sammy Burke said, "What you doing?" I said, "Well, things are kind of rough. I don't know, I'm thinking about getting a day job and working on the weekend, just playing my horn." Because I'd been playing with Lester Lanin, too, and Meyer Davis, and me and Urbie Green , you know, we played along with the big band, then we'd come down in front and do, "Basin Street," or, "I Got Rhythm," or something, while the band was on intermission.
